description: Total file count and bytes for the allowed roots, broken down by file extension and by directory. Reports file-content sizes, which will not match a disk utility exactly.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return, at most 10,000.

max_files.description: Stop after this many files, at most 1,000,000. The result says so when the cap is hit.

path.description: Directory to scan. Omit to scan every configured root.
